items.bridge: The target now owns exact contained registry, artifact-metadata, schema, duplicate, organization, and identity reads plus a private complete-plan review. Connected shortcut and cross-provider index execution are intentionally unavailable rather than approximated, and move, rename, delete, dispatch, and copy-as-move remain prohibited.

The target proves external shortcut form, one exact registered home, current document schema options, bounded Link and Name duplicate reads, complete private review, and zero provider writes during preparation.

The target can select only registered destinations, uses the configured inbox as an explicitly provisional fallback, leaves required owner, organization, and type gaps visible, and never invents a folder, relation, or option.

The target emits an exact private human-move instruction without a move capability, refuses copy-as-move, surfaces pressure to skip the required index, and holds every write when any complete-plan invariant is unresolved.

Only the Drive Filing preparation and review responsibility inside this mixed Publishing source is target-owned. The Publishing card remains present and legacy-authoritative for its other mapped governance responsibilities.
